crossRefs.note: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning…
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from…
It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet gave it light by…
He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of…
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a…
They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: In the morning watch, Yahweh looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
translations.bsb: At morning watch, however, the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, and He threw their camp into confusion.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning watch, that Jehovah looked forth upon the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and discomfited the host of the Egyptians.
